entities.summary: James R. Riffey was an American professional basketball player. Riffey was selected in the second round of the 1950 NBA draft by the Fort Wayne Pistons after a collegiate career at Tulane. He played for the Pistons in 35 total games in 1950–51. He died in January 2018 at the age of 94.
